slot: Default deploy stack (SaaS + API + MCP server)

pick.name: Vercel Pro + Supabase Pro + Better Auth + R2 + Resend + Sentry + PostHog
pick.what: Fully managed paid stack for a Next.js SaaS
pick.why: Best DX on a paid, commercial-OK footing: Vercel Pro for the app, Supabase Pro for Postgres/storage/backups; about $45/mo before usage. Supabase Auth is the fewer-parts choice; Better Auth is the no-lock-in choice
pick.free_limits: Vercel Pro $20/seat, Supabase Pro $25; Resend, Sentry, PostHog free tiers to start

best_free.name: Cloudflare Workers + Neon + Better Auth + R2 + Resend + Sentry + PostHog
best_free.what: Edge-first $0 stack with a remote-MCP template
best_free.why: $0 until >100k req/day or >10 ms CPU (Workers Paid $5); >1 GB/project (Neon Launch); >100 emails/day (Resend Pro $20); >5k errors (Sentry Team $26); >1M events (PostHog pay-go)
best_free.free_limits: Free tiers of all components allow commercial use per their pages (see per-slot notes)

alts.name: Container path: Cloud Run + Neon + Better Auth
alts.what: Same stack but Docker on Cloud Run
alts.why: For Python/FastAPI agents or long requests
alts.free_limits: Cloud Run free 2M req/180k vCPU-s; card required

alts.name: Railway all-in-one (Hobby)
alts.what: Containers, workers, cron and databases on one platform

candidates.name: Vercel Pro variant
candidates.verdict: Alt if paying from day one

candidates.name: Always-free VM + Coolify
candidates.verdict: All self-hosted; most ops; good for internal tools

decision: Default to Vercel Pro + Supabase Pro when paying from day one for the least ops; use the Cloudflare Workers + Neon stack to run at $0 until real traffic. Workers Paid ($5/mo) is the first upgrade because it lifts CPU, cron, queue and log limits at once. For HIPAA/PHI workloads none of the free tiers should hold PHI; budget for BAA-capable paid plans.
details: Card checkout must be a hosted processor or MoR page: Cloudflare ToS forbids collecting card data on Free-plan properties (earlier research).

verify.note: Prices verified (Vercel Pro $20/seat, Supabase Pro $25). But 'fewest moving parts' conflicts with pairing Supabase Pro (which includes Supabase Auth) with a separate Better Auth library. Either use Supabase Auth in the paid stack or justify Better Auth (users in your own tables, no auth lock-in).
